0022600030.text: The Raptors (4-4, 2-3 on the road) visit the Milwaukee Bucks (1-7, 1-3 at home) in this 9th game of the Raptors' season, with Toronto coming off a loss and sitting 3.5 games back in the Atlantic Division. Toronto is missing Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness), while Milwaukee is without Kam Jones (ankle), who is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Raptors won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 122-94 win in Milwaukee on February 22, 2026.
